Slowly, they began to communicate with each other and live together on the White Plateau.
As the Melloblum performed the Dance of Blissful Bloom, the white flower blossomed against the bitter cold and whirling snow.
It was called the "whitesnow rose"—a miracle on the snow.
The miracle of a beautiful flower blooming amid a harsh and unforgiving world.
And the miracle of the Bloomville folk and Budsquires living together and helping each other.
